Windows SDRplay sample server build provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/SDRplay/RSPTCPServer
Commit: 61b8c915635aa2d57b51e5a99a26f11ab26c81c6
Files copied from upstream: rsp_tcp.c, rsp_tcp_api.h, getopt/getopt.c,
getopt/getopt.h, README.md, LICENSE.

The source changes are: in rsp_tcp_api.h, guard the upstream empty definition
of __attribute__(x) with #if !defined(__GNUC__) so MinGW can compile it; in
rsp_tcp.c, pass a u_long (rather than an int pointer) to ioctlsocket. Trailing
whitespace was also removed from the two top-level source files.

Build environment: Ubuntu 24.04, official gcc-mingw-w64-x86-64-posix package,
official SDRplay API 3.15 Windows import library and header. No proprietary
SDRplay library or installer is included in this repository. The user installs
the API separately after reviewing its license.

From this directory (with the SDRplay API import library mounted at the path
shown), run rebuild-windows.sh or build with:

x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -static -Wl,--no-insert-timestamp -D_GNU_SOURCE \
  '-DSERVER_NAME="rsp_tcp"' '-DSERVER_VERSION="0.1"' \
  -I'/mnt/c/Program Files/SDRplay/API/inc' -I. \
  rsp_tcp.c getopt/getopt.c \
  '/mnt/c/Program Files/SDRplay/API/x64/sdrplay_api.lib' \
  -lws2_32 -lpthread -o rsp_tcp.exe

SHA256 rsp_tcp.exe:
93F007D74AAFFBF8B7F1EBC05402B09F6CB424E39BE612A1DE19EC13559028CD
